name: Reflected XSS in Unescaped Search Query Parameter
description: DAST fuzz probe discovered search endpoint reflects 'q' parameter without HTML entity encoding, rendering '<script>' into DOM.

failure_vector.error_log: SecurityVulnerabilityFinding: Reflected XSS detected at /api/v1/search. Unescaped payload rendered into DOM.

expected_resolution.healed_code: const sanitizedQuery = encodeURIComponent(query); const res = await request.get(`/api/v1/search?q=${sanitizedQuery}`); assert !res.text().includes('<script>');
